Placement: Direct Hire, Full-Time 
 
 

 
 
 Product Engineer BCS - HMI 
 
 Job Description & Duties: 
 
 

 
 Responsibilities for the Senior Product Engineer (BCS) include but are not limited to the following:
 Designing and developing test set-ups for the testing and evaluation of HMI features (buttons, rotaries, displays, etc.) 

 DFSS and CAE analysis
 Developing DFMEA and coordinating computational analysis of components
 prototype builds and validation process and design validation testing
 Participate in APQP process throughout the product development cycle
 Failure analyses and problem resolutions related to HMI feature concern
 Creating finite element models translated from CAD models through UG NX or from 2D drawings
 Evaluate and recommend necessary design changes or other solutions to improve quality or reduce costs.
 
 Job Requirements & Qualifications: 
 

 Experience with HMI product design or similar product
 Five years of CAD experience.
 Six Sigma Black Belt/ Green Belt certification preferred.
  
 Salary Range: 80-100K DOE 
 Contact: Jennifer Lau - North Star Staffing Solutions 

 If you meet the requirements of this unique opportunity, we encourage you to explore how you can make a difference by applying now. Simply respond to this ad by submitting a Word version of your most recent resume.
